basics.type: Private university, formerly Roorkee College of Engineering
basics.ugc: UGC-recognised state private university; AICTE-approved B.Tech
basics.campus: 20-acre campus on the Ganga Canal, about 5 km from Roorkee
basics.other: Engineering (CSE, AI & ML, ECE, Civil, Mechanical, EEE), computer applications, commerce, business, pharmacy and allied health sciences

admission: Class 12 with Physics, Maths and Chemistry/Computer Science, 45% (40% reserved)
HUAET (Haridwar University's admission test) or other eligible routes; lateral entry for diploma holders in CSE, AI & ML and ECE
BCA, B.Com, business, pharmacy, allied health

scholarships.text: 25% of first-year tuition for Uttarakhand domicile students and for girls (2026 and 2027 Class 12 pass-outs), with merit scholarships on marks and JEE or CUET percentiles. Only one scholarship per student.

hostel.text: Separate hostels for boys and girls. Hostel fee, including mess and laundry, is ₹85,000 a year for a normal room, ₹95,000 semi-deluxe and ₹1,05,000 deluxe AC.

fees.text: For the 2026 intake, B.Tech (Hons.) CSE tuition is ₹62,000 a year, with a first-year total of ₹1,32,000; B.Tech AI & ML costs ₹1,62,000 in the first year.

title: Haridwar University Roorkee: Admission 2027, Fees
desc: Haridwar University, Roorkee (formerly Roorkee College of Engineering): B.Tech admission, 2026 fees, hostel fees, scholarships and free guidance.
